stem: Which investigation is most appropriate for measuring glomerular filtration rate in an older school-aged child when cortical scarring and obstruction are not the main concerns?
explanation: Tc-99m DTPA renal functioning scan is the correct answer because it is used for glomerular filtration rate measurement, particularly in older children.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Renal Functioning Scan (MAG-3/DTPA)

rationale: : The key clinical question here is GFR measurement, which is what DTPA is used for rather than cortical scarring or obstruction.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because DMSA is used to assess renal cortical defects, scarring, and differential renal function, not GFR measurement
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because MAG3 is more useful for assessing renal drainage and obstruction and is commonly used in younger children or reduced renal function
optionExplanations.C: Correct because Tc-99m DTPA is the nuclear medicine study used to measure glomerular filtration rate, especially in older children
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because an abdominal X-ray does not measure renal function or glomerular filtration rate
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because renal Doppler ultrasound can assess renal blood flow and anatomy but does not provide a nuclear medicine GFR measurement
